resources.string: End-to-end encrypted bookmarks, synced with your browsers.
Your bookmarks are encrypted on this device with your password and SyncID. The server never sees them.
You will get an emergency kit with your SyncID. Keep it safe: with your password it is the only way to sign in on other devices.
This device was signed out by the server. Sign in again with the same account; your bookmarks on this device are kept.
Save this kit now: print it, or store it in your password manager. Without it and your password, nobody can recover your synced bookmarks.
This removes your bookmarks from this device. They stay on the server and your other devices.

This permanently deletes your account and all synced bookmarks from the server, and signs out every device. This device\'s bookmarks are removed; bookmarks in your browsers are kept. This cannot be undone.
Type your username (%1$s) and password to confirm.
